title: is_none_or requires Rust 1.82; MSRV is 1.85 so this is fine, but verify
description: walk.rs uses Option::is_none_or() which was stabilized in Rust 1.82. MSRV in Cargo.toml is now 1.85 so this compiles. However the CLAUDE.md top-level workspace file says MSRV 1.75 for mime-tree — this is now stale/conflicting with the per-crate Cargo.toml which was bumped to 1.85. The workspace CLAUDE.md still says 'MSRV: 1.75 (mime-tree)'. Need to update the workspace CLAUDE.md to 1.85 so downstream contributors don't set up the wrong toolchain.
close_reason: MSRV is 1.85; is_none_or requires 1.82. No issue.
